Privacy Policy
Effective Date: 4 October 2026
Website: https://fragroot-riverine-perfumes.edgeone.dev/
Business Name: Fragroot | Riverine Perfumes
1. Introduction
Welcome to Fragroot | Riverine Perfumes. We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information when you visit our website, browse our products, place an order, or communicate with us.
This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, how we protect it, and what choices you have regarding your personal information.
By using our website, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
2. Information We Collect
We may collect the following types of information when you interact with our website or purchase our products.
2.1 Personal Information
When you place an order, create an account, or contact us, we may collect:
•	Full name
•	Mobile phone number
•	Email address
•	Billing and delivery address
•	Order details and purchase history
•	Information you provide through customer service messages
2.2 Payment Information
We may collect payment-related information necessary to process your purchases. Payments may be handled by third-party payment providers, mobile financial services, banks, or cash-on-delivery services.
We do not intend to store complete payment card details on our website.
2.3 Technical Information
When you visit our website, certain information may be collected automatically, including:
•	IP address
•	Browser type and device information
•	Pages visited and time spent on the website
•	Referring website or traffic source
•	Website usage and interaction data
2.4 Cookies and Similar Technologies
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, maintain shopping cart functionality, improve website performance, and understand visitor behaviour.
You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Some website features may not function properly if certain cookies are disabled.
3. How We Use Your Information
We use the information collected for the following purposes:
•	To process, confirm, and deliver your orders.
•	To communicate about order status, delivery, returns, and customer support.
•	To manage payments, refunds, and order records.
•	To improve our website, products, services, and customer experience.
•	To prevent fraudulent transactions, misuse, and unauthorized activities.
•	To send promotional messages, product announcements, offers, and updates where permitted.
•	To comply with applicable legal, tax, accounting, and regulatory obligations.
We collect and use only the information reasonably necessary for these purposes.
4. Sharing of Personal Information
We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
However, we may share relevant information with trusted service providers when necessary to operate our business, including:
•	Delivery and courier companies: To deliver your orders.
•	Payment service providers: To process payments and refunds.
•	Website hosting and technology providers: To maintain our website and related systems.
•	Analytics and advertising providers: To measure website performance and advertising effectiveness, where applicable.
•	Legal and regulatory authorities: When disclosure is required by applicable law or a lawful request.
We expect service providers handling personal information on our behalf to use it only for authorized purposes and to apply appropriate safeguards.
5. Order Processing and Delivery
To fulfil your purchase, we may share your name, phone number, delivery address, and relevant order details with courier companies and delivery personnel.
This information is used to facilitate delivery, contact you regarding your order, and resolve delivery-related issues.
We recommend providing accurate contact and delivery information to avoid delays or unsuccessful deliveries.
6. Marketing and Promotional Communications
With your consent where required, we may send you information about new perfume arrivals, perfume oils, attars, decants, special offers, discounts, and other products or services.
You may opt out of promotional communications at any time by following the unsubscribe instructions, where available, or by contacting us directly.
Please note that even if you opt out of marketing messages, we may still contact you regarding your orders, payments, deliveries, or other essential service-related matters.
7. Data Security
We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.
However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security of information transmitted through the internet.
If a security incident affects your personal information, we will take appropriate steps in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
8. Data Retention
We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, including order fulfilment, customer service, accounting, legal compliance, and dispute resolution.
When information is no longer required, we will take reasonable steps to delete it, anonymize it, or securely dispose of it, subject to applicable legal retention requirements.
9. Your Privacy Rights
Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:
•	Request access to personal information we hold about you.
•	Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
•	Request deletion of personal information where legally permissible.
•	Withdraw consent for certain types of data processing.
•	Opt out of promotional communications.
•	Ask questions or raise concerns about how your personal information is handled.
To exercise these rights, please contact us using the details provided in the Contact Information section below. We may need to verify your identity before processing certain requests.
Some information may need to be retained where required for legal, accounting, security, or legitimate business purposes.
10. Third-Party Websites and Services
Our website may contain links to third-party websites, social media platforms, payment services, or other external services.
These third parties may have their own privacy policies and data handling practices. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of websites and services that we do not operate.
We encourage you to review the privacy policies of those third parties before providing personal information.
11. Children's Privacy
Our website is intended for general consumers and is not specifically designed to collect personal information from children.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable law. If we become aware that personal information has been collected unlawfully from a child, we will take appropriate steps to address the situation.
12. International Data Transfers
Some of our website hosting, analytics, payment, or technology service providers may process information outside Bangladesh.
Where personal information is transferred across borders, we will take reasonable steps to ensure that the transfer and subsequent processing comply with applicable legal requirements and appropriate data protection safeguards.
13. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our business practices, website functionality, technology, or applicable laws.
Any updated version will be published on this page with a revised effective date. We encourage you to review this page periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.
14. Contact Information
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the handling of your personal information, please contact us:
Business Name: Fragroot | Riverine Perfumes
Website: https://fragroot-riverine-perfumes.edgeone.dev/
Email 1: riverineperfumes@gmail.com

Phone/WhatsApp: +880 1748-127559

We will make reasonable efforts to respond to privacy-related inquiries within an appropriate timeframe.
________________________________________
By using our website, you acknowledge this Privacy Policy and the practices described in it, subject to any consent requirements under applicable law.
